title: A Recipe for the Locker
author: Sebastian Eriksen
blurb: Elodie Marchetti, a scholarship student at an academy with too many secrets, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship before the final audition.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
